name: Beacon of celestial darkness
slug: A column of felt darkness that rises while the active staff is held.
description: Also called a beacon of eternal blackness, a beacon of blackness, and a pillar of darkness. It is a swirling column of ink, almost light, with a shadowy wave that can be felt passing through everything.

log.summary: It erupts from the treeline at the door-testing grounds when Sylan grabs the active staff, and it keeps rising while Ord and Sylan have their hands together on it. Walker and Dana both witness it from the stronghold. Dana flies toward it, and Walker, Elrus, Araden, and Glimmen divert from the Grazog trip to follow. When Sylan lets go, the beacon disappears. A faint outline lingers for a few blinks, and the clearing dies in light.

When Sylan lets go, the beacon disappears. A faint outline lingers for a few blinks, and the clearing dies in light.

log.summary: When Sylan grabbed the staff, a black pillar shot up as the spirits were drawn into him. From New Navel, earlier the same day, it read as a giant beacon or column of light over Trigash Forest, which Haldor places at midmorning. Haldor bet Erwin 25 gold that it was a random event and not the party; Erwin bet it was the stronghold hooligans with a new dragon. The party was seen flying toward the forest and back about an hour later, and Erwin won.
